choices.content: As long as the sample is randomly selected from the population and its size is appropriate, it can reflect the population reasonably well
The larger the sample size, the more representative the sample must be, regardless of the selection method
Selecting only acquaintances makes the sample more convenient and more representative

question.prompt: Which of the following statements about sample representativeness is correct?

solutions.explanation: Representativeness depends on whether the selection method is random and whether the sample size is appropriate. When the sampling method is biased, even a large number of people does not necessarily make the sample representative.
solutions.title: Representativeness and selection bias
